blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
React isn't a new language — it's a JavaScript library. You're still writing JavaScript. React just gives you extra tools on top.

rows: You call the library when you want
The framework decides the structure for you

blocks.content: React is a library — you decide when to use it, how to structure your files, and how to fetch data. Frameworks make those decisions for you.
This is why "React is JavaScript" is accurate. Your existing JS knowledge — functions, arrays, conditionals, objects — works exactly the same inside React.
It layers on top of what you already know, not beside it.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
